reportedIssues: The promotional badge on the pizza card reads '-0%', which is a meaningless/zero discount and looks like a data or formatting bug.

The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the name 'Trattoria Piccol' hard-clipped at the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card image is also abruptly cut, making it unclear the row is scrollable.
Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circle with dark outline on the ramen card, dark circle with white outline on the pizza card.
The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom tab bar with no visible title or metadata, leaving an incomplete-looking viewport bottom.
Category chip row is cut off mid-chip at the right edge and the notification bell dot has no textual indication, so unread state and additional filters may be missed by some users.
